summary:
Cadabra rebrand verification (both backend brand endpoints + landing + /app). All six acceptance checks pass except (a) the hero

has an intentional
('Make your
transactions vanish.'), so a strict substring search for 'Make your transactions vanish.' in element.innerText fails (whitespace becomes \n). The exact string is present in document.title and visually in the hero, so this is cosmetic for strict testing only. (b) Mobile 390px horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=645 vs 390) is still present and in fact slightly worse than iteration 6 (was 514). Dominant offenders are decorative absolute-positioned background blur divs with large widths whose ancestor sections lack overflow-hidden/overflow-x-clip, plus the activity-feed/stats on the right-rail extending to 508px (same tech-section pattern as iter 6). All backend brand endpoints verified: /api/bifrost/v1/_brand/lockup.svg -> 200 image/svg+xml with Cada/bra tspans; mark.png and favicon.png -> 200 image/png; /favicon.ico -> 200; /brand/favicon-32.png?v=2 and /brand/cadabra-mark.png?v=2 -> 200. Landing '/' (desktop 1920): title='Cadabra | Make your transactions vanish'; nav logo img alt='Cadabra', naturalWidth=512, src=/brand/cadabra-mark.png?v=2, visible; wordmark 'Cadabra' rendered; eyebrow 'The privacy layer for Solana · multiple routes' present; nav link [data-testid=landing-nav-zk] scrolls to #zk showing zk-system-0..2 cards and 5-step pipeline (Private information → ZK circuit → Groth16 proof → On-chain verifier → Accept or reject). Forbidden brands (Veil, Darkinator, DarkSwap, Houdini, NEAR Intents, 1Click, Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, ContractWolf, Privacy Cash) are all absent from document.body.innerText. /app loads with title 'Cadabra App'; top-left lockup img src contains /api/bifrost/v1/_brand/lockup.svg (naturalWidth=456); onboarding card shows 'Create a Cadabra wallet' + 'Import your Cadabra wallet'; sidebar shows CadabraSwap, Private route, Privacy swap, Track order; 'Veil' and 'Darkinator' absent from in-app text. Regression /app#private-route: SOL (2) → Ethereum ([data-testid=dk-chain-ethereum] present and clickable) → USDC → 0x68b3…41f6 produces 3 routes (Route 1 BEST 209.0489 USDC, 208.9441, 208.7381) and an active 'Review swap' button. /app#privacy-swap loads with SOL preselected and no forbidden brand text.

ui_bugs.issue: scrollWidth=645 at 390px viewport (was 514 in iter 6). Top wide elements: decorative absolute blur divs (e.g., '.absolute -top-40 left-1/2 h-[620px] w-[1100px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full ...') and a right-rail activity-feed <table.w-full.text-left.text-sm> that extends to right=508px. Fix: add overflow-x-clip (or overflow-hidden) to the hero and real-ZK/stats section containers wrapping the decorative blobs; add min-w-0 to grid cells and wrap long tables in a scroll container (overflow-x-auto on the table's parent).

h1.innerText is 'Make your\ntransactions vanish.' due to an intentional
on line 82 of LandingPage.jsx. document.title has the full 'Make your transactions vanish.' string, so this is semantically correct, but strict single-line substring tests on h1 will fail. Consider using whitespace-normalise or remove the
so h1.innerText matches exactly.

action_items: Fix mobile 390px horizontal overflow: wrap decorative absolute blur divs' section in overflow-x-clip, and give the right-rail activity <table> an overflow-x-auto parent.
(Optional/LOW) Normalise hero <h1> so plain-text match of 'Make your transactions vanish.' works, or document that automated string checks must use title/aria-label.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/bifrost_brand.py: lockup_svg inlines a base64 PNG every request (~63KB each). Consider caching the SVG bytes once at import time to avoid re-encoding per request.
Logo.jsx is used in both landing (public) and in-app contexts but hard-codes the ?v=2 query. If the brand mark is updated, callers must bump this cache-buster manually — consider centralising.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
All Cadabra rebrand acceptance criteria are met across landing and /app. Backend brand endpoints (_brand/lockup.svg, mark.png, favicon.png) and public favicons (/favicon.ico, /brand/favicon-32.png, /brand/cadabra-mark.png) return 200. Only outstanding issue is the mobile horizontal overflow (same family of bug reported in iter 6) which has grown slightly to 645px — root cause is decorative absolute-positioned blur containers lacking overflow-x-clip plus the activity-feed table on narrow screens. Private-route regression (SOL→ETH USDC) and privacy-swap load pass. Hero

contains a hard
, so prefer document.title for string-level brand assertions.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow: multiple hero/background sections place decorative <div class='absolute ... w-[1100px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-...'> blurs inside sections that do NOT have overflow-x-clip, so the blur extends the document scrollWidth to ~745px. Additionally, the live-activity <table class='w-full'> inside the right rail renders at ~508px wide because its parent column uses a fixed min width via flex layout and lacks min-w-0 / overflow-x-auto wrapper. Fix: (a) add 'overflow-x-clip' to the <section> that wraps the hero and the 'What Solana sees' / live-stats block; (b) wrap the <table> in a <div class='overflow-x-auto -mx-4 px-4'> or set the parent column to 'min-w-0'.
